newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise Inns to buy UK pub co Discovery.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise Inns to buy UK pub co Discovery.

text.p: British pub company Enterprise Inns Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Discovery Inns Plc for 19.5 million stg and the repayment of long-term debt amounting to 26.7 million stg.
Enterprise also said it would raise some 33.2 million stg net of expenses through a three-for-eight rights issue of up to 17.7 million new ordinary shares at 196p per share.
Enterprise said it believed the acquisition would enhance earnings per share in the first full financial year of operation.
Discovery has 232 tenanted public houses and 45 managed pubs, bringing Enterprise's portfolio to over 1,100 pubs in England and Wales.

"Enterprise is already pursuing further attractive acquisition opportunities which, following the rights issue, it intends to finance with new and existing bank facilities where appropriate," the firm said in a statement.
Enterprise's shares were marked up 0.5p at 242.5 by 0735 GMT.
Enterprise also reported interim results, posting a 74 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 6.2 million stg on turnover of 23.6 million stg for the six months to March 29.
